content: अगोचर {%a.%} Imperceptible by the senses, not obvious. See गोचर; वाचामगोचरां हर्षावस्थामस्पृशत् <ls>Dk. 169</ls>, beyond the power of words, indescribable. .{@-रम@} .²1 Anything beyond the cognizance of the senses. .²2 Not being seen or observed, or known; कथं देवपादानामगोचरेणैवं क्रियते <ls>H. 2</ls>; without the knowledge of; ˚तां गतान् <ls>Pt. 2</ls>. .²3 Brahma; अगोचरे वागिव चोपरेमे <ls>Ki. 17. 11</ls>.
